high_stakes.why: CI runs the gates, so a weakened workflow lets every later bad change merge unseen
The pre-commit hook runs the gates, so a weakened hook lets every later bad change commit unseen
The verification, review, setup, and state scripts are the gates, so a weakened script passes every later bad change
Agent hooks, permissions, and the evaluator and reviewer definitions live here, so a weakened one lets agents skip checks or judge their own work
